load_saved_model: load a PyTorch model's saved state dict from a file path and apply it to the model
move_tensors_to_cuda: recursively move all PyTorch tensors in a nested dict or list sample to the CUDA device
convert_tensors_to_half: recursively convert all FloatTensor tensors in a nested dict or list sample to half precision
tokenize_text_with_basic_tokenizer: run basic tokenization with punctuation splitting, lower casing, and accent stripping on a piece of text
project_predicted_text_to_original: project a tokenized prediction string back to the original text using character-to-character alignment
